programmes.specialization: Civil & Environmental Engineering (1630): port and hinterland freight transport systems

Its school research centre explicitly describes two PhD work packages in port/hinterland freight digital twin and synchromodal supply-chain scheduling: agent-based simulation-optimization and predictive freight/container handling scheduling. Current centre research inventory explicitly includes logistics and transport operations. This is a substantive doctoral logistics/OR pathway within broad Civil/Environmental PhD, not generic traffic control or physical civil construction.

Active status refers to current broad doctoral provision and documented logistics research pathway, not a guaranteed open project intake.
Two work packages/positions are within one Civil doctoral research pathway, not two extra degrees.
